target.description: Denoise the original neural fluorescence recordings while preserving fast voltage/calcium dynamics and source real-time constraints. The real voltage fidelity endpoint compares denoised pixel fluorescence traces with simultaneous electrophysiology, not with a fabricated clean fluorescence image.

dataset.description: Source raw data are deposited at Zenodo 15872025; Figure 3d–f uses a QuasAr6a-expressing cortical neuron and simultaneous patch clamp, while the registered scope also retains real calcium imaging. Exact archive files/version, full collection inclusion and native export manifest remain unresolved.

cohort.description: Figure 3d describes 4,982 frames from the 1,000-Hz mouse L2/3 example, 1,000 displayed pixel traces and a separate n=100-pixel correlation comparison in Figure 3f. Their exact pixel identities and independence are not recovered; this is not 100 independent neurons or animals. Calcium collection identity also remains to be bound.

split.description: Methods treat the full input stack as a sample for self-supervised temporal-window training (default 100 epochs). Preserve the source allowance for unlabeled same-stack adaptation and protect electrophysiology/reference labels. The local recording-disjoint split disallowing test-stack adaptation is a separate extension.

inputs.description: Same raw fluorescence stack, imaging frame rate/exposure and permitted spatiotemporal context as source FAST; synchronized electrophysiology is an evaluator comparator, not a candidate training target. Synthetic clean traces belong only to the source simulation controls.

preprocessing.description: Recover original ROI/pixel selection, fluorescence baseline definition, electrophysiology synchronization, temporal context, overlap handling, clipping and full-frame support. The local fixed-ROI/F0 rules are explicit prospective choices; paper weight decay 1e-4 and pinned README 0.9 are not silently interchangeable.

metric.description: Figure 3f uses Pearson correlation r=sum((x-xbar)(y-ybar))/sqrt(sum((x-xbar)^2)sum((y-ybar)^2)) between single-pixel ΔF/F and synchronized electrophysiology. Figure 3b analogously compares simulated traces with clean truth; image PSNR/SSIM and throughput are distinct outcomes.

aggregation.description: Exact pixel-level source summaries and baseline numeric correlation are not recovered. Report source strata separately; pixel/frame correlations cannot justify animal-level confidence, and prospective ROI/recording/group means cannot be substituted for the paper reduction.

full_panel.description: The registered real neuronal-calcium and single-cell-voltage scope requires the complete original Figure2 raw-plus-five-method Accuracy/Recall/F1 panel over all155 annotated neurons and8000 frames; Figure3d-f raw/FAST fluorescence-electrophysiology comparison with original100-pixel quantitative and1000-pixel displayed rosters over4982 frames; Figure3a-c raw-plus-five-method controls for every2/4/6/8ms spike-width condition and10 simulated neurons; and original Figure1d matched-hardware throughput with temporal-fidelity/stride controls. Preserve full raw/denoised movies, fixed source traces, morphology and segmentation outputs, not only favorable aggregates. The exact Figure1b stride grid and the required routing of additional Figure3g-i zebrafish and Figure4 astrocyte collections into this registered task are unbound; no reduced panel or full-five-collection claim is admitted. This is a PARTIAL scalar inventory, not complete canonical coverage: Figure3b requires the full 24 method-by-width distributions of 10 original neuron correlations each (all 240 coefficient identities plus clean/noisy/denoised traces, original spike shapes/times and source statistical comparisons); Figure3f requires both raw and FAST panels of 100 original pixel correlations each (all 200 coefficient identities and full synchronized traces), with the separate 1000 displayed-pixel roster preserved. No mean, median, selected exemplar, categorical claim or other invented scalar may replace these structured panels.

permitted_observations.description: Both paired information conditions must permit the same complete source raw fluorescence stacks, frame identities/rates and source-allowed unlabeled same-stack training. Original electrophysiology, clean synthetic targets, manual masks and final metric references remain operator-owned. The paper is common input and its printed results are known answers, so aggregate agreement cannot prove computation. Author code is the only additional information in the +code condition; code-derived temporal oracle and route diagnostics are operator-side by default. Whole-stack centering in the pinned CLI and GUI needs the last original frame; both routes use all-pixel augmented-stack means, and their different tail-window support must be disclosed. Exact original C/S, training extent, weights provenance, source route, runtime budgets and enforceable delivery/exposure manifests remain unbound.
